summary: Amazon Q Developer for VS Code 1.84.0 shipped with an injected destructive prompt
details: Version 1.84.0 of the extension was built from a repository into which an attacker had committed a prompt instructing the agent to delete local files and cloud resources. AWS reports a syntax error prevented execution. The version was withdrawn.

database_specific.why: AVE mirrors component-level records into OSV form so existing OSV scanners can use them without knowing AVE exists. Records OSV cannot express faithfully are marked. See ALTERNATIVES.md.
